**Fig. 1** Study design. Ten detectors were given only the first 3–6 fields of each series. E1: sensitivity and specificity against a future-confirmed reference in held-out UWHVF eyes; E2: false-alarm rate on true no-change series (12 weekly fields per patient); E3: shuffle audit (false-alarm rate after randomly re-ordering each eye's fields), which was also used to calibrate thresholds (amendment A3); E4: external data set (GRAPE, Octopus G1 perimeter) with the rule-based progression labels supplied with the data.

**Fig. 2** Sensitivity against the future-confirmed reference (26 progressing eyes) versus false-alarm rate on true no-change series, by number of fields. The shaded band marks false-alarm rates at or below the nominal 5%. Bars are 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. D1 trend test (OLS-MD); D2 MD-rate rule; D3 PLR-3; D4 PoPLR; D5 pooled conformal test; D6 detrended conformal test; D7 event analysis; D8 gradient-boosted trees; D9 recurrent network; D10 order network.

**Fig. 3** External data set (GRAPE). Sensitivity versus 1 − specificity against the MD progression label supplied with the data set, using the first three (left) or four (right) fields; bars are 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. D6, D9 and D10 require the 24-2 pattern and were not applied.

**Fig. 4** Shuffle calibration (amendment A3, exploratory). Panels 1–4: sensitivity against the future-confirmed reference versus false-alarm rate on true no-change series with the nominal threshold (open symbols) and with the threshold reset to a 5% flag rate on shuffled series of the clinic's own validation eyes (filled symbols, arrows), for three to six fields; D1 (trend test) for comparison. Shaded band: false-alarm rates at or below 5%. Right panel: specificity (left bar of each pair) and sensitivity (right bar) in the external data set (GRAPE, three fields) with nominal (nom.) and own-clinic shuffle-calibrated (cal.) thresholds. D2 MD-rate rule; D6 detrended conformal test; D8 gradient-boosted trees; D9 recurrent network.
